# dsh-media-gen
English | 日本語
Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key alre
ady configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.**
## Features
- Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation

card or command.
- Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for

image or video generation.
- Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default).

Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session.
- English and Japanese UI; c
ommand responses are English.
## Compatibility
Choose a release for your DSH version from GitHub Releases. Supported versions and changes are recor
ded in CHANGELOG.md.
## Installation
Replace `<tag>` with the full release tag you selected:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be au
thenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile.
To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs th
e latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular r
t `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release.
To remove:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH after removal.
In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key.
## Usage
*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation ed
ited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.*
### Generation cards and chat
Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available genera
te…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options.

- **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details.
- *
*Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed
itten** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first.
You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/ima
ge --count` instead repeats the same prompt.
Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card usi
ng the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the
input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft.
Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply
to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval.
### Commands
Place options before the prompt and quote paths containing spaces with `"`.
| Command | Purpose |
| `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--

yes] <prompt>` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs |
| `/video [--model id] [--d
uration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--
last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] <prompt>` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames an

d reference images |
| `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediat

ely |
| `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults |
| `/media-model image` | List image mod

el IDs |
| `/media-model image <model-id> [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation |
| `/m

edia-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection |
| `/media-approval on` | Allow genera

tion in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation |
| `/media-approval off` | Restor
e normal per-request confirmation |
Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; se
lections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own mode
l argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card mode
l through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection.
### Approval and costs
Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent request
s ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate
unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conver
sation permission; only the user can change it.
Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second genera
tion call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `require
Approval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to th
roval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them.
Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges.
Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable
response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image re
quest fails, already saved images are returned with the failure.
## Limitations
- Input images are sent to OpenRouter. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 20 MiB are accepted, and

the model must support the requested input images or frames. API keys are not sent to the browser.
-
Avoid common output-folder names such as `Pictures`. To display older outputs, the image route also

accepts images in matching output folders without distinguishing working directories.
- Video previ

ews support mp4, m4v, webm, and mov up to 32 MiB, independently of the download limit.
- When durati
on is omitted, `maxVideoSeconds` can limit the model's default only if its catalog lists supported d

urations.
- Without DSH storage, video tracking does not survive restarts.
